paragraphs.text: Maeve is a siren from an unspecified plane.
Like all sirens, Maeve is a seductive creature who uses her hypnotic voice to create shipwrecks on the sea. Unlike other known sirens, Maeve's lower body is composed of octopus-like tentacles.

Maeve is a captivating yet fearsome figure, a siren whose beauty is belied by her capacity for manipulation and destruction. Her ability to compel others to do her bidding while reaping the benefits of their actions makes her a dangerous force in the realm she inhabits, embodying the perilous allure and treachery of the sea.
